test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pavement**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank refers to the specific area on a street intended for pedestrians.
 
• The phrase "the place for the foot passengers" directly describes this area.
 
• A "**pavement**" (also known as a sidewalk) is the designated walking area beside a road.
 
• The other options ("road", "market", "bay") do not refer to the area where pedestrians are meant to walk along a street.

 

Complete Passage: *That was a jolly story 1. which__ Arthur Ransome told the other day in one of his messages from Petrograd, a place in Russia. A stout old lady was walking 2. __with__ her basket down the middle of a street to the 3. __great__ confusion of the traffic and with no small peril to herself. It was pointed 4. __out__ to her that the 5. __pavement__ was the place for the foot passengers, but she replied, “I’m going to walk where I like. We’ve got liberty now.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Road: The part of a street or highway used by vehicles.
 
• Market: A public gathering for buying and selling goods.
 
• Bay: A broad inlet of the sea or a recessed area.
